ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels exceeding 90% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-gray to black contiguous region; high-contrast circular blobs (radius 3-8 pixels) distributed across central and lower lobes; high-intensity, high-frequency textured clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; estimated pixel angle of 65-70 degrees; depth occupies roughly 25% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency sawtooth pattern; amplitude of variations ranging from 2 to 12 pixels; serration frequency of approximately 12 peaks per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex upward curve originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black background) scattered across both lobes; approximately 10 discrete clusters on the left lobe and 5 on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity, rough-textured biological accretion (likely barnacle colonization) at the distal tips of both lobes, creating an irregular, jagged profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-intensity circular focal spot located in the upper quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
